scope: Runpod workflow, capacity interpretation and exact runtime constraints. Published documentation is not deployment evidence.

sources.title: Runpod Pods overview
sources.supported_claims: Dedicated GPU/CPU container environment and storage/connection options.

sources.title: Runpod Pod pricing
sources.supported_claims: Compute/storage meters, running versus stopped storage, deprecated savings plans, balance and data-loss behavior; reviewed current Oct23 text.

sources.title: Runpod Serverless pricing
sources.supported_claims: Worker billing lifecycle; model loading and idle timeout; Flex/Active distinction; active discounts require sales inquiry.

sources.title: Runpod public GPU pricing
sources.supported_claims: Dated public Pod/Serverless GPU and storage prices. Retrieved page does not expose selected Pod cloud toggle reliably; not an account offer.

sources.title: Runpod GPU model listings
sources.supported_claims: Alternative advertised starting offers; differs from pricing page. Not silently substituted for a selected-region quote.

sources.title: Runpod GPU types
sources.supported_claims: GPU identifiers and nominal memory; does not establish host RAM, topology, stock or account price.

sources.title: Choose a Runpod Pod
sources.supported_claims: Secure versus Community infrastructure; existing Community resources remain available, new hosts no longer accepted.

sources.title: Runpod network volumes
sources.supported_claims: Regional persistent volume lifecycle, standard tariffs, mounting and balance exhaustion. Performance numbers are vendor claims.

sources.title: Runpod Pod storage options
sources.supported_claims: Container/volume/network/global persistence, Pod attachment rules, encryption scope, mount paths and backup guidance.

sources.title: Runpod high-performance storage
sources.supported_claims: Premium regional tier; exact pricing varies by datacenter; speedup figures are internal vendor benchmarks.

sources.title: Runpod global-volume overview
sources.supported_claims: Beta read-heavy region-independent storage; Class A/B request rates retrieved in primary search extracts. Direct page fetch repeatedly failed; exact storage tariff remains unverified.

sources.title: Global volumes for Serverless
sources.supported_claims: GPU-only beta route; regional independence, mount path and creation-method/SDK limitations.

sources.title: Manage Pods
sources.supported_claims: Create/stop/start/update/terminate semantics and container/system logs; running-container edits can reset ephemeral data.

sources.title: Zero GPU Pods on restart
sources.supported_claims: Stopped capacity may be reassigned; storage recovery and redeployment possibilities.

sources.title: Expose Pod ports
sources.supported_claims: Public HTTP proxy, HTTPS,100-second timeout, direct TCP and no UDP; application authentication needed.

sources.title: Serverless load-balancing overview
sources.supported_claims: Direct custom HTTP routes, no queue/backlog or built-in retry, readiness codes/paths,2-minute wait,5.5-minute processing,30MB payload.

sources.title: Build a load-balancing worker
sources.supported_claims: Container/server contract, authenticated client examples and WebSocket support/handshake startup timeout; tutorial is not our deployment.

sources.title: Serverless endpoint settings
sources.supported_claims: Workers/GPUs/scaling, regional constraints, lifetimes, FlashBoot and inactivity downscaling. Embedded GPU tariffs conflict with pricing page; preserve discrepancy.

sources.title: Send queue-based API requests
sources.supported_claims: Input envelope, job identity/status, execution/TTL policies, result retention, operation rate limits and retry operations.

sources.title: Queue endpoint operation reference
sources.supported_claims: Streaming operation and maximum1MB streamed payload chunk; queue contract, not a generic OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

sources.title: Serverless handler functions
sources.supported_claims: Queue handler input contract and10MB run/20MB runsync payload guidance.

sources.title: Runpod cached models
sources.supported_claims: HF host caching, supported public/gated/private models and pre-worker download billing distinction; no measured startup guarantee.

sources.title: Runpod vLLM environment variables
sources.supported_claims: Packaged-worker settings and version-sensitive defaults; not universal upstream engine options.

sources.title: Runpod vLLM configuration
sources.supported_claims: Model-specific parser, template and loader options; exact wrapper/image support still needed.

sources.title: Runpod vLLM request formats
sources.supported_claims: Discovery of packaged-worker request documentation; consult pinned implementation before an integration. No API request made.

sources.title: vLLM conserving memory
sources.supported_claims: Weight loading/sharding, context and batch memory, CUDA graphs and multimodal CPU/GPU costs.

sources.title: vLLM engine arguments
sources.supported_claims: Prompt-plus-output model length, revision identity, explicit cache budgets, sequence/batch/admission knobs, quantized cache and CPU offload. Latest docs are not a pinned image.

sources.title: vLLM quantization
sources.supported_claims: Hardware/backend compatibility and mixed quantization controls; selected model/version may impose additional restrictions.

sources.title: Hugging Face chat templates
sources.supported_claims: Model-specific role/control tokens, generation prompt and special-token duplication; exact serialization needed for counting.

sources.title: Download files from Hugging Face Hub
sources.supported_claims: Revision pinning, snapshots, file-selection patterns and cache behavior. Documentation read only; no model download.

sources.title: Runpod secrets
sources.supported_claims: Encrypted secret references in templates; runtime substitution instead of hardcoding credentials.

sources.title: Runpod credentials
sources.supported_claims: Separation of account/API/SSH/registry credentials and secrets; no account credentials inspected.

sources.title: Runpod terms of service
sources.supported_claims: March24 2026 terms, sections6/7 broad content language. No explicit lawful-fiction inference exception established; no claim of technical filtering or legal clearance.

sources.title: Runpod rolling releases
sources.supported_claims: Progressive worker replacement, active-job completion and mixed-image overlap; strict version cutover requires deliberate procedure.

sources.title: NVIDIA CUDA minor-version compatibility
sources.supported_claims: CUDA major-family driver floors and feature/PTX caveats; a model can require more than the generic minimum.

sources.title: vLLM parallelism and scaling
sources.supported_claims: Tensor/pipeline parallel and distributed serving distinctions; interconnect and per-rank model support matter.

sources.title: Runpod account-secret API
sources.supported_claims: Boot-time secret references, write-only values and scoped authentication; documentation only, no account mutation.

sources.title: Runpod CLI Pod operations
sources.supported_claims: Desired/runtime status distinction and evidence of termination; no CLI operation executed.
